edges.details: Average balance in Coinbase products during Q3; approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization per Coinbase. Not net new capital or XRP purchases.
Coinbase's SEC filing states the arrangement was renewed on the same terms; this does not imply a new or expanded Circle agreement.
Coinbase reports fourth consecutive quarterly market-share gain; aggregate company metric, not XRP-specific share.
Annualized revenue run rate, not recognized Q3 revenue and not an XRP market measure.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is expanding into multi-issuer stablecoin distribution while retaining Circle/USDC economics and adding Ripple/RLUSD access.
hypotheses.minority_objection: The RLUSD listing may become a substitute rather than an additive channel; no post-launch balances are available.

hypotheses.claim: RLUSD could displace some USDC balances or distribution economics on Coinbase.
hypotheses.minority_objection: Q3 USDC balances were record-high and the Circle arrangement was renewed on the same terms, but both observations predate the RLUSD listing.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's revenue mix is becoming less dependent on spot crypto trading.
hypotheses.minority_objection: Transaction revenue fell sharply year over year; diversification has not removed cyclical exposure.

hypotheses.claim: RLUSD settlement growth on XRPL will create material XRP demand.
hypotheses.minority_objection: RLUSD can settle directly; only measured XRP bridge/AMM/fee/reserve demand would establish value capture.
